body.message:
Hello Yulia,

We completely understand your concern and sincerely apologize for the delay in receiving your security deposit refund.

We have checked with our Finance Team, and they have also explained the process to your husband. Please note that deposit refund payments are released only between Monday and Thursday. As per our records, your refund was processed on 16 September, and you should receive the payment next week, between Monday and Thursday.

We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience and understand that the delay may be frustrating. The refund has already been processed from our side, and the remaining timeframe is related to the required management approval and payment release process, which is beyond our direct control.

We truly appreciate your patience and understanding, and we are very sorry once again for the delay.
